'''Nicki''' was an [[Ewok]] who lived in [[Bright Tree Village]] on the forest [[moon]] of [[Endor]].<ref name="ROJ" />

==Biography==
Nicki was an [[Ewok]] who lived on the forest [[moon]] of [[Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Nicki was part of the tribe of [[Bright Tree Village]] and was present when a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Endor strike team|strike team]] led by [[General]] [[Han Solo]] was brought to the village by members of the tribe. When the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] told stories about the Rebels' adventures during the war, Nicki was present to hear the tale. Nicki was later present in the Bright Tree Village celebration commemorating the Rebel victory after the [[Battle of Endor]]. During the celebration, Nicki danced with [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket W. Warrick]].<ref name="ROJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nicki appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The character was portrayed by [[Nicholas Read]], who was credited in ''Return of the Jedi'' as Nicki Reade.<ref name="SWI 67">{{InsiderCite|67|Beyond the Valley of the Ewoks}}</ref>
